title: Series vs Parallel Circuits
guideExplore: Compare series and parallel — same bulbs, different paths and brightness.
guideSeries: Series: one path. Current is the same through both bulbs.
guideParallel: Parallel: each bulb gets full voltage and usually shines brighter.
conditionsHint: Series shares one current; parallel gives each branch full voltage.
quizQuestion: In a series circuit with two identical bulbs…
quizCorrect: They share the same current and are usually dimmer than in parallel
quizWrong: Each bulb always gets the full battery voltage
learnMore: Series = one loop for both bulbs. Parallel = separate branches that share the battery.
